description: This file defines the primary class HTMLPurifier, which orchestrates the process of filtering and sanitizing HTML content to ensure it is safe for output on web pages. It includes functionality for configuration, filtering, tokenization, and generating purified HTML, serving as the main interface for the HTML Purifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier
classes.description: The main class responsible for orchestrating the HTML filtering process, including configuration management, tokenization, filtering strategies, and output generation. Implements singleton pattern for managing a single instance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HTMLPurifier instance with a given configuration, defaulting to a created configuration if none is provided.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a custom filter object to the list of filters to be applied during purification. Deprecated method.

methods.name: purify
methods.description: Filters an HTML string to produce a sanitized, XSS-free, standards-compliant output based on the current configuration.

methods.name: purifyArray
methods.description: Processes an array of HTML snippets, returning an array of purified outputs.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Implements the singleton pattern to return the sole instance of HTMLPurifier, optionally accepting a prototype to override or initialize the instance.
